The phase

Sign convention

The DFT notes, Smith's book, the complex DFT, MATLAB and numpy all define Im X[k] with −sin. Try the other button to see why the sign matters: without the minus, every phase and every slope flips.

Dr. Seán Mullery · Atlantic Technological University. Simulated data: blade-pass vibration and its harmonics, white noise, 1/f noise, mains interference and an 8th-order anti-alias filter, in a 65,536-sample (about 6.8 minute) recording. Works offline once downloaded.
Dr. Seán Mullery · Atlantic Technological University. Recordings: C5 on electric guitar and on trumpet, built into this page. You can load your own WAV files, which stay on your computer. Works offline once downloaded.
Dr. Seán Mullery · Atlantic Technological University. Frequencies are given as a fraction of the sampling rate, as in Smith, chapter 9. The continuous curve is the DTFT of the windowed samples. Works offline once downloaded.
Dr. Seán Mullery · Atlantic Technological University. Phase is computed from the DFT and unwrapped bin by bin. Shapes after Smith, chapter 10. Works offline once downloaded.
